nights.title: mary in the junkyard
nights.name: Mary in the Junkyard
nights.extract: Mary in the Junkyard are a British band from London. The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Clari Freeman-Taylor, viola and bass player Saya Barbaglia and drummer David Addison. The band are signed with All My Friends (AMF) Records. They have been compared to Adrianne Lenker and Wolf Alice.

nights.extract:
Nicolas Demuth, known by stage name Parra for Cuva, is a German musician and DJ.
He is best known for his house production.

nights.title: Slaughter To Prevail: North America 2026 Leg 2
nights.name: Slaughter to Prevail
nights.extract: Slaughter to Prevail is a Russian-British-American deathcore band formed in 2014 in Yekaterinburg and currently based in Orlando, Florida, United States. The band has had numerous line-up changes over the years, with Russian vocalist Aleksandr "Alex Terrible" Shikolai and British lead guitarist Jack Simmons as the only constant members. The current line-up features Russian musicians with bassist Mikhail Petrov, drummer Evgeny Novikov, and rhythm guitarist Dmitry Mamedov.
